note: Fon du Lac Park District campground and marina on the Illinois River (Upper Peoria Lake) in East Peoria, beside an industrial area. Paved sites on one-way loops; sites 49 and 53-55 sit on open grass above the marina's backwater bay. Five unpaved beach sites are on the river sand, and the primitive Cone Park area is a gravel lot beside the river. No tent camping; rental cabins, boat launch and slips at the marina. --Claude
